title: Healthcare market research: methods for patient and consumer decisions
summary: Healthcare market research methods for patient and consumer decisions. Governance frameworks, study designs, and workflows for pharma and insurance teams.
body_markdown:
What is the difference between healthcare market research and pharmaceutical market research? +


Healthcare market research is the broader discipline, covering patients, clinicians, caregivers, and payers across any healthcare context. Pharmaceutical market research is a subset focused on commercial questions for drug and treatment brands, such as message testing, adherence barriers, and prescribing behavior.


Why do healthcare consumer research studies get delayed by clinical review? +


Most organizations route every study through the same legal, medical, and regulatory (LMR) review queue, regardless of whether the study makes a clinical claim. Routine consumer behavior research gets caught behind studies that genuinely require that scrutiny, because there's no separate, pre-defined pathway for the two types of work.


How long does a typical healthcare depth interview program take? +


Traditional, synchronous depth interview programs typically take four to six weeks from recruitment through synthesis. Asynchronous, AI-moderated video interviews remove the scheduling dependency, which is the primary driver of that timeline, and can compress it substantially.


What compliance certifications should a healthcare research vendor have? +


Enterprise healthcare procurement teams generally require SOC 2 Type II certification, GDPR compliance, and EU-based hosting for any program involving European participants, along with role-based access control, audit trails, and configurable data retention.


How is continuous healthcare market research different from a one-time study? +


A one-time study captures a snapshot of patient or clinician sentiment at a single point in time. Continuous, wave-based programs, such as Conveo StoryLines, run on a set cadence, for example, bi-weekly or monthly, and monitor how that sentiment shifts over time, so teams can catch early signals rather than discovering a shift after it has already affected the business.
